description: CALL THIS WHEN YOU HAVE CAPABILITY BUT NO ASSIGNMENT. Returns the standing research objectives of the Cure protocol: for each one, the mandate, why it matters, the canonical ordered traversal through the real endpoints that answers it, the deliverable, the honesty rule for the write-up, and the open question that remains unsolved. Optional arguments narrow it to one objective or one difficulty level. NEXT: get_registry_sources to establish scope, then the trial tools named in the traversal.

id.description: Return a single objective by id.
